As per the prosecution case the Applicant was dealing with  contraband material which is unsafe and dangerous for the health  of people.
4. It is the submission of Mr. Sachin Chandan, learned Counsel  that except the offence under Section 328 of IPC, all other offences  are bailable offences.
He submits that as far as Section 328 of IPC  is concerned, the Supreme Court is considering the applicability of Section 328 of IPC to the similar cases.
He therefore, states that  the Anticipatory Bail be granted.
5. On the other hand, Ms. Newton, learned APP strongly  opposes the Anticipatory Bail Application.
She submits that the  offence is very serious and therefore, the Anticipatory Bail  Application be rejected.

7. The Supreme Court in the said order has imposed the above  condition in case of similar offence.
8. Perusal of the record shows that except the offence under Section 328 of IPC the other offences are bailable offences.
The  issue whether Section 328 of IPC will apply to similar cases is  pending before the Supreme Court.

Although there is one  antecedent of similar nature, the same is of the year 2022 and the  Applicant has been granted Anticipatory Bail by learned Single  Judge by order dated 19th June 2023 passed in Anticipatory Bail  Application No. 496 of 2023 in that case.
 9.

(a) In the event of arrest of the Applicant- Ravindra B. Sabale in connection with C.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with one or two solvent sureties in the like amount.
(b) The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police Station once in a month till filing of the chargesheet and shall cooperate with the investigation.

(c) The Applicant to furnish an undertaking that he will not deal with banned products i.e. Gutkha,
Pan Masala with Tobacco products in any manner whatsoever.
Such undertaking is to be filed in this Court within a period of two weeks from today.
The Applicant to strictly comply with the said undertaking.

(d) The Applicant shall furnish his cell phone number and residential address to the Investigating Officer and shall keep the same updated, in case of any change Page 5 603-ABA-543-2023.ODT Akash Tayde thereto.

(e) The Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat, or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such a person from disclosing the facts to the Court or to any Police personnel.
